title: Benny Benoit, the Crystal Palace and a band's members
summary: He recalls playing with the drummer Benoit at the Crystal Palace in Depression time, compares drummers, and lists the members of a band and the boys who came to fetch him.

story.theme_name: Drummers and drumming: who played what, and how
story.community_name: Great drummers: who they admired and why

blocks.x: Well, you mentioned outside some, who was it that Saeed's brother-in-law or something? Oh, Benny Benoit.

I was playing with him with the Liberty Band, but I gnawly passed. That's years ago. I remember when I gnawly passed and myself, we were playing at the Crystal Palace in Depression time up on Clio and Radha, near Drys. And all the boys from Browns, the ice cream company used to come there, you know. And I know I told him, son, you don't drink now. I said, no, son. He said, well, don't turn no beer on. When they bring you the beer, give it to me. When the boys bring the ice cream, I give it to you. So, I ate the ice cream, he drank the beer. Yeah. But he was a very fine drummer. He reminds, he and L.E.P. guys remind me, I close my eyes, I sound like the same people playing drums. You know, when they got that good, bright leg and they put that time down, let's stay at that.
And it sounds like, who did you say?
He and L.E.P. guys are players alike. Oh, alike.
Oh, I thought you were going to say they sound like somebody else. No, he and L.E.P.
Yeah, they do. Yeah, that's right.

They're alike. They had some nice times in the band. They had, Zeddy Johnson was playing saxophone with them too. And a fellow by the name of Tom Copeland lived down around Maurice Durand House. He was playing bass. And Albert Francis' wife was playing piano. Albert Francis drummer, his wife was playing piano in his band. And this fellow played trumpet, what they call Cuckoo. I think his right name is Tavern. Yeah. I got a picture of him home. And he was playing trumpet. Used to get plenty of weight. Plenty of weight. But he used to come at my house and get them and my mom used to tell him, you can take them if you're going to bring them back home. You had to bring them back home. Yeah. Well, mine used to have to come get me and bring me back home too. Minor would play bass. Oh yeah. Come get me and my little brother and have to bring us back home if you can take us.
Also, this drummer lived back on Gravity Street with that Peter Williams. Yeah. Yeah.
He had to bring me back home too.
